definitions.explanation: A person who oversees an examination to ensure rules are followed and no cheating occurs. In Japanese educational settings, teachers or designated staff serve this role.

examples.japanese: {試験監督|しけんかんとく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}って→従う：02059_shitagau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please follow the exam proctor's instructions.

examples.japanese: {試験監督|しけんかんとく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡回|じゅんかい}→巡回：12407_junkai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The exam proctor is walking around the classroom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{試験監督|しけんかんとく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{各教室|かくきょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: For university entrance exams, multiple proctors are assigned to each classroom.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (examination) + ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ (supervision/supervisor). Often abbreviated to ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧ in context when the exam setting is clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試験監督|しけんかんとく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as an exam proctor
- {試験監督|しけんかんとく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧: proctor's instructions
- {試験監督|しけんかんとく}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: exam supervisor (formal variant with the person suffix)
- {試験監督|しけんかんとく}⟦{補助|ほじょ}→補助：14105_hojo⟧: assistant proctor

USAGE:
In Japan, {試験監督|しけんかんとく} is a formal role during important exams like ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧ (university entrance exams) and qualification tests. The proctor reads aloud the exam rules, distributes and collects papers, and monitors for irregularities. University faculty commonly take on this duty as part of their administrative responsibilities.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧: supervisor; director — broader term used in many contexts (sports, film, etc.)
- ⟦{監視|かんし}→監視：05521_kanshi⟧{員|いん}: monitor; surveillance staff — emphasizes watching rather than administering
- ⟦{採点者|さいてんしゃ}→採点者：24882_saitensha⟧: grader; scorer — the person who marks the exam, not who supervises it
